gloss: broad daylight, middle of the day

definitions.gloss: broad daylight, middle of the day
definitions.explanation: The brightest part of the day, emphasizing that it is clearly daytime with full sunlight.

examples.japanese: {真|ま}っ{昼間|ぴるま}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{寝|ね}ている→寝る：00470_neru⟧。
{真|ま}っ{昼間|ぴるま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦なんて→なんて：06918_nante⟧。
examples.english: To do such a thing in broad daylight!

examples.japanese: {真|ま}っ{昼間|ぴるま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{繁華街|はんかがい}→繁華街：09392_hankagai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: An incident occurred in the busy downtown area in broad daylight.

notes:
{真|ま}っ{昼間|ぴるま} emphasizes 'right in the middle of the day' or 'in broad daylight.' The {真|ま}っ prefix intensifies the meaning, similar to ⟦{真|ま}っ{暗|くら}→真っ暗：07616_makkura⟧ (pitch dark) and ⟦{真|ま}っ{赤|か}→真っ赤：03734_makka⟧ (bright red).

USAGE:
Often carries surprise or criticism — the speaker implies the action is inappropriate or unusual for daytime. Common with actions normally done at night or in private.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {真|ま}っ{昼間|ぴるま}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧〜: doing ~ starting from broad daylight (implies laziness or boldness)
- {真|ま}っ{昼間|ぴるま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧〜: doing ~ in broad daylight (implies brazenness)
- {真|ま}っ{昼間|ぴるま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{繁華街|はんかがい}→繁華街：09392_hankagai⟧: downtown in broad daylight

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{昼間|ひるま}→昼間：01713_hiruma⟧: daytime (neutral)
- {真|ま}っ{昼間|ぴるま}: broad daylight (emphatic, often judgmental)
